intro.zh: 今天这批项目透露出一个清晰信号：AI 正在从「能跑」走向「可控」。无论是设计系统、生成式 UI 还是浏览器代理，重点都不再是让模型自由发挥，而是用预定义组件、schema 和知识图谱给它划出边界。对创业者来说，机会不在再做一个更聪明的模型，而在做那层把不确定性收拢成可交付结果的约束层。
intro.en: The through-line today is control, not capability. Design systems, generative UI, and browser agents are all shifting from letting models improvise toward constraining them with predefined components, schemas, and knowledge graphs.

zh.summary: 面向艺术家和影视创作者的 AI 图像视频创作 IDE，先在 2D 构图、3D 摆场景，再选模型生成，强调可重复的精确结果。它解决的是纯提示词无法控制角色一致性和镜头的问题。
zh.insight: 适合切短视频和广告分镜这类需要角色一致性的垂直工作流，卖「可复现的镜头」而非「一次生成」；和通用文生图工具差在前期场景搭建。

en.summary: An AI image and video IDE for artists and filmmakers: compose in 2D, stage in 3D, then pick a model. It targets creators who need repeatable control over character identity and…
en.insight: Target short-video and ad storyboard workflows where character consistency matters, selling reproducible shots rather than one-off generations.

items.description: ArtCraft is an intentional crafting engine for artists, designers, and filmmakers

zh.summary: 开源浏览器代理库，可用任意 LLM 本地运行，也提供带隐身浏览器的托管云和 API，能像人一样填表、过验证码、完成预约。它解决的是网页自动化里反爬和登录态难题。
zh.insight: 适合做垂直行业的「代客操作」服务，比如签证预约、政务表单代填，按成功结果收费；与通用爬虫相比，它的价值在能处理交互和验证码。

en.summary: An open-source browser agent library that runs locally with any LLM, plus a hosted cloud with stealth browsers and an API.
en.insight: Build vertical done-for-you services like visa bookings or government form filing, charging per successful outcome.

items.description: Open-source Python library for AI browser agents, plus Browser Use Cloud: stealth browsers and a hosted agent API.

zh.summary: 从 RAG 引擎演进成「agent 原生数据库」的上下文基础设施，融合检索与 agent 能力，适配各种规模企业。它解决的是 agent 需要可靠、可管理的长期上下文的问题。
zh.insight: 适合做面向垂直行业的私有化知识底座，切法律、医疗等对数据合规敏感的客户；与通用向量库相比，它把检索流程和 agent 编排打包好了。

en.summary: A RAG engine that grew into an agent-native database and context layer, fusing retrieval with agent capabilities for enterprises of any size.
en.insight: Offer a private knowledge base for regulated verticals like legal and healthcare. Versus a generic vector store,

items.description: RAGFlow is an agent-native database: a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) engine that grew into context infrastructure.
items.category: AI 基础设施 / 模型

zh.summary: Google Colab 的命令行工具，可在终端秒开 CPU、GPU、TPU 运行时，执行本地代码、管理远程文件、编排流水线，面向无头自动化和 agent 集成。它解决的是临时算力获取繁琐的问题。
zh.insight: 适合做面向小团队的「按需 GPU 任务队列」，切模型微调和批量推理场景；与自建集群相比，它把临时算力变成一条命令，降低试用门槛。

en.summary: A CLI for Google Colab that spins up CPU, GPU, or TPU runtimes in seconds, runs local code, manages remote files,
en.insight: Build an on-demand GPU job queue for small teams doing fine-tuning and batch inference. Versus standing up a cluster,

items.description: A CLI for interacting with Google Colab runtimes

zh.summary: 一个野心极大的单体仓库，试图从零重写并开源全世界的软件，从 Office、Slack 到 Photoshop、AutoCAD 都列在路线图里。它反映的是对专有软件订阅制的集体反弹。
zh.insight: 别把它当产品，当趋势信号看：开源替代专有软件的需求真实存在，机会在挑一个高频单点做深，而不是铺开做全家桶。

en.summary: An ambitious monorepo aiming to rebuild and open-source the world's software from scratch, with Office, Slack, Photoshop, and AutoCAD on the roadmap.
en.insight: Treat it as a signal, not a product: demand for open alternatives to proprietary tools is real. The opening is going deep on one high-frequency tool,

items.description: We're rebuilding and open-sourcing the world’s software from scratch.

zh.summary: Meta 内部用了八年的设计系统开源，150+ 无障碍组件，基于 React 19 和 StyleX，主打「人和 agent 一起构建」并自带 CLI。它解决的是 AI 生成界面时组件不统一、品牌失控的问题。
zh.insight: 可以围绕它做企业级主题定制与组件治理服务，切「让 agent 产出符合品牌规范」的场景；与裸用 Tailwind 相比，它自带约束和可访问性，省掉后期返工。

en.summary: Meta's eight-year internal design system, now open source: 150+ accessible components on React 19 and StyleX, with a CLI and agent-ready theming.
en.insight: Sell theme customization and component governance on top, aimed at enterprises that want agent output to stay on-brand.

items.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready

zh.summary: 生成式 UI 框架，让 AI 从提示词生成界面，但只能使用你预先定义的组件目录，输出严格匹配 schema，支持流式渲染和 React、Vue、Svelte 等多端。它解决的是 AI 生成界面不可靠的问题。
zh.insight: 可以基于它做面向 SaaS 的「自然语言配置后台」，切运营人员改仪表盘、表单的场景；与让模型直接吐 HTML 相比，护栏让结果可预测、可维护。

en.summary: A generative UI framework where AI builds interfaces from prompts but only from your predefined component catalog, with schema-validated output, streaming,
en.insight: Build natural-language admin panels for SaaS, aimed at ops teams editing dashboards and forms. Versus having models spit out raw HTML,

zh.summary: 轻量级服务器监控平台，带 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警，配置简单、开箱即用，支持多用户和 OAuth。它解决的是自建服务器和 homelab 用户不想上重型监控的问题。
zh.insight: 可以做成面向小型托管商的托管监控增值服务，切「替客户盯服务器」的场景；与 Prometheus 相比，它更轻、部署更快，适合资源有限的小团队。

en.summary: A lightweight server monitoring platform with Docker stats, historical data, and alerts, easy to set up out of the box with multi-user and OAuth support.
en.insight: Turn it into a managed monitoring add-on for small hosting providers watching servers on clients' behalf.

items.description: Lightweight server monitoring with historical data, docker stats, and alerts.

zh.summary: Xray-core 的网页控制面板，支持 Vmess、Vless、Trojan、WireGuard 等多种协议，提供多语言界面和单机到多节点的部署管理。它解决的是自建代理配置复杂、多用户计费难的问题。
zh.insight: 适合做面向小团队的合规网络接入管理，切跨境办公和远程访问场景；与手写配置相比，面板把协议和流量计费可视化，降低运维门槛。

en.summary: A web control panel for Xray-core supporting Vmess, Vless, Trojan, WireGuard, and more, with a multilingual UI and management from a single VPS to multi-node setups.
en.insight: Target small teams needing compliant network access management for cross-border work and remote access.

items.description: Supporting multi-protocol multi-user(Vmess, Vless, Trojan, ShadowSocks, Wireguard, Hysteria, Tunnel, Mixed, HTTP, Tun, MTProto، AmneziaWG)

zh.summary: 覆盖中小学数学、英语、物理的知识图谱，含上千知识点、先修边和题库，对齐课标，附自适应前置诊断，答错能沿先修关系回溯到具体薄弱点。它解决的是个性化学习缺乏结构化底座的问题。
zh.insight: 可以基于它做错题诊断和自适应练习产品，切家长愿意付费的提分场景；与题库类应用相比，先修图能定位到根因知识点，而不只是推同类题。

en.summary: A K-12 knowledge graph for math, English, and physics with thousands of concepts, prerequisite edges, and a question bank aligned to China's curriculum,
en.insight: Build error-diagnosis and adaptive practice products for parents paying for score gains. Versus question-bank apps,

items.description: 数学（小学到高中）、英语（三年级到高中）、初中物理的知识图谱：1644 个知识点、2403 条先修边、6723 道题，对齐课标，附自适应前置诊断。
